versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the stack-rebase skill.
- Enables cascading rebases of entire PR stacks after a base PR merges or upstream branch changes.
- Documents all steps: fetching remote state, identifying triggers, running cascading rebase, conflict resolution, force-pushing, and updating pull requests.
- Includes guidance for both git and jj workflows with `--update-refs` support.
- Outlines required progress tracking and best practices to prevent conflicts in stacked PR workflows.
